mapper.select: SELECT A.PWPL_ID, A.CHCK_SNO, A.PRCDOC_SNO, A.CHCK_STRT_DT, A.CHCK_END_DT, TO_CHAR(CHCK_STRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_CHCK_STRT_DT, TO_CHAR(CHCK_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_CHCK_END_DT, TO_CHAR(CHCK_STRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(CHCK_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHCK_DT, A.CHCK_TITL, A.WRKOR_NO, A.CHKPR_ID, A.CHKPR_FNM, A.CNMR_ID, A.CNMR_FNM, A.AAWPR_ID, A.AAWPR_FNM, A.ATWT_RQST_YN, A.PRCDOC_RVSN_NO, A.PRSTS_CFY, CASE WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'R' THEN '준비' WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'A' THEN '허가' WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'F' THEN '수행' WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'S' THEN '정지' WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'C' THEN '완료' ELSE '' END AS PRSTS_CFY_NM, C.PRCDOC_NO, C.PRCDOC_NM, C.DOC_TYP_CD, C.PRT_NO FROM GE_PL_CHCK01_M A JOIN GE_PL_PRCDOC01_M C ON A.PRCDOC_SNO = C.PRCDOC_SNO WHERE A.CHCK_SNO = #{CHCK_SNO}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_PL_CHCK01_M ( PWPL_ID, CHCK_SNO, PRCDOC_SNO, CHCK_STRT_DT, CHCK_END_DT, WRKOR_NO, ATWT_RQST_YN, CHCK_TITL, PRSTS_CFY, CHKPR_ID, CHKPR_FNM, CNMR_ID, CNMR_FNM, AAWPR_ID, AAWPR_FNM, DLT_YN, PRCDOC_RVSN_NO, ATFL_ID, FIRST_CRTE_DT, FIRST_CRER_ID, LAST_MDF_DT, LAST_UPDR_ID ) VALUES ( #{PWPL_ID}, #{CHCK_SNO}, #{PRCDOC_SNO}, #{CHCK_STRT_DT}, #{CHCK_END_DT}, #{WRKOR_NO}, #{ATWT_RQST_YN}, #{CHCK_TITL}, #{PRSTS_CFY}, #{CHKPR_ID}, #{CHKPR_FNM}, #{CNMR_ID}, #{CNMR_FNM}, #{AAWPR_ID}, #{AAWPR_FNM}, 'N', #{PRCDOC_RVSN_NO}, #{ATFL_ID}, SYSDATE, #{FIRST_CRER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{LAST_UPDR_ID} )
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_PL_CHCK01_M SET CHCK_STRT_DT = #{CHCK_STRT_DT}, CHCK_END_DT = #{CHCK_END_DT}, CHCK_TITL = #{CHCK_TITL}, CHKPR_ID = #{CHKPR_ID}, CHKPR_FNM = #{CHKPR_FNM}, CNMR_ID = #{CNMR_ID}, CNMR_FNM = #{CNMR_FNM}, AAWPR_ID = #{AAWPR_ID}, AAWPR_FNM = #{AAWPR_FNM}, WRKOR_NO = #{WRKOR_NO}, ATWT_RQST_YN = #{ATWT_RQST_YN}, LQAST_UPDR_ID = #{LQAST_UPDR_ID}, LAST_MDF_DT = SYSDATE WHERE CHCK_SNO = #{CHCK_SNO}
